text:
nora: Heads-up: gpu-autoscaler in us-east-1 flapping after IAM boundary change. New boundary blocks role chaining used by peered deployers -> nodes failing key decrypt and healthchecks. anyone else seeing join failures?

raj: yep. autoscaler spun up 40 nodes, 12 failed join with decrypt/access denied errors. sample log: ```2026-03-23T12:02:11Z ERROR keystore: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for arn:aws:sts::333333333333:assumed-role/peered-deployer-role/session```

sam: looks like the org IAM boundary now strips sts:AssumeRoleFromWebIdentity? audit-hardening PR enforced new boundary last night. cross-account assume flows get blocked.

secops-bot: policy-change: iam-boundary-enforced for org-unit=platform at 2026-03-23T00:15Z.

nora: mitigation ideas: 1) temporary create-grant for peered-deployer-role (low friction), 2) revert boundary (bad), 3) have peered deployers assume a cross-account role we pre-authorize at onboarding.

raj: prefer 1+3. I'll script create-grant with 48h TTL and tag with RB-2026-15. need secops approval for emergency grant.

sam: also suggest adding a monitoring alert: if decrypt errors > 5/min for a pool, auto-create grant after human approval window. avoids manual firefights.

secops-bot: emergency-grant approved with 48h TTL and audit tag required. please document exact ARNs in the incident INC-2026-1492.

ops-bot: INC-2026-1492 created. mitigation applied at 2026-03-23T12:30Z by raj. 12 nodes recovered. monitoring 2h.

nora: postmortem action items: update peer-onboard to register a scoped keystore grant on acceptance, add privatelink-keystore to roadmap (cost estimate in ticket), and require boundary-change preflight tests for high-churn compute subnets.

raj: will open PR to automate short-lived grants + expiration watch. thanks team. :thumbsup:
